questions.q: What does a 'security context' name in Oracle Fusion's security model?
options: The specific privilege a role grants
The specific enterprise-structure dimension that a data security grant is scoped by
The password policy applied to a user
The name of the job role itself
questions.explain: A security context identifies which dimension (such as Business Unit or Data Access Set) a particular data security grant applies to.

questions.q: Which security context is most associated with Fixed Assets?
options: Business Unit
Control Budget
Asset Book
Data Access Set
questions.explain: Asset Book is the security context used to scope Fixed Assets data, since that is the natural unit Fixed Assets organizes its data around.

questions.q: What are the four parts of a complete role assignment?
options: Username, password, email, and phone number
Job role, abstract role, duty role, and privilege
Ledger, chart of accounts, calendar, and currency
User, role, security context, and context value
questions.explain: A complete role assignment binds together the user, the role granting function access, the security context naming the dimension, and the context value — the specific instance of that dimension.

questions.q: James Okafor at Castellan Robotics is given the General Ledger Accountant job role and a security context of Data Access Set, but no context value is ever entered. What is the most likely result?
options: James has the correct job role but no actual ledger data to work with
James automatically gets full access to every ledger in the company
The system rejects the role assignment and deletes the user account
James is blocked from signing in entirely
questions.explain: Without a context value specifying which data access set applies, James's job role is correctly assigned but has no specific data scope attached, leaving him without usable ledger data.

questions.q: A user has the Accounts Payable Specialist role with Business Unit = US Operations. If the business unit value is changed to EMEA Shared Services, what happens to their access?
options: Nothing changes, since the role itself is identical
The job role is automatically revoked
Their access changes, because the context value is part of what defines the full assignment
They gain access to both business units simultaneously
questions.explain: Changing any one of the four parts of an assignment — including the context value — produces a different assignment and therefore different effective access.
